summary.text: Brad Stephens is a Republican member of the Illinois House of Representatives for the 20th District, serving since June 2019, according to the Illinois General Assembly.

paragraphs.text: Stephens's legislature biography says Stephens is mayor of Rosemont, served on the Rosemont Board of Trustees for 18 years, and previously served on the Illinois State Toll Highway Authority and the Pace Bus Board of Directors.
